questions.text: A sum of money amounts to ₹ 12,100 in 2 years at 10% per annum compound interest compounded annually. Find the principal.
questions.solution: Shortcut: For 2 years at 10%, the amount factor is (1.1)² = 1.21; principal = 12,100 ÷ 1.21 = 10,000. Full solution: Using A = P(1 + R/100)ⁿ, we have 12,100 = P(1 + 10/100)² = P × 1.21, so P = 12,100 / 1.21 = ₹ 10,000.

questions.text: Rahul walks 10 km North, then turns right and walks 6 km. Then he turns right again and walks 10 km. Finally, he turns left and walks 5 km. How far is he from the starting point?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Net Displacement Method. Cancel opposite vertical movements (North 10 − South 10 = 0). Add horizontal movements in same direction (East 6 + East 5 = 11). Distance = 11 km. Full Solution: Start (0,0). North 10 → (0,10). Right (East) 6 → (6,10). Right (South) 10 → (6,0). Left (East) 5 → (11,0). Distance from origin = √(11²+0²) = 11 km.

questions.text: How many operational and training commands does the Indian Army currently have in total?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Standard Defence GK fact: 6 Operational Commands (Western, Eastern, Northern, Southern, South Western, Central) + 1 Training Command (ARTRAC) = 7. Step-by-step: The Indian Army is organized into 7 commands. Six are operational/field commands headed by GOC-in-C (Lieutenant General). The seventh is the Army Training Command (ARTRAC) at Shimla, responsible for training policies. No new command has been raised recently.

questions.text: Who was appointed as the first Governor-General of Bengal under the Regulating Act of 1773?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Chronological elimination. Regulating Act 1773 created the post. Warren Hastings was the serving Governor of Bengal (since 1772) and became the first GG. Cornwallis came later (1786), Wellesley (1798), Bentinck (1828). Full Solution: The Regulating Act of 1773 was the first step by the British Parliament to regulate the affairs of the East India Company in India. It elevated the Governor of Bengal (Warren Hastings) to the position of 'Governor-General of Bengal' and created an Executive Council of four members to assist him. Warren Hastings served from 1773 to 1785. Lord Cornwallis succeeded him in 1786.

questions.text: In a monohybrid cross between two heterozygous tall pea plants (Tt × Tt), what is the phenotypic ratio of tall to dwarf plants in the F₂ generation?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Mendel's Monohybrid Cross phenotypic ratio is a fixed standard: 3 Dominant : 1 Recessive. No Punnett square drawing needed in exam. Worked: Parental gametes: T, t. F₂ genotypes: TT, Tt, tT, tt. Phenotypes: Tall (TT, Tt, tT) = 3; Dwarf (tt) = 1. Ratio = 3:1. Option D (1:2:1) is the genotypic ratio.

questions.text: An article with a marked price of ₹ 500 is sold after two successive discounts of 20% and 10%. What is the selling price?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Equivalent single discount = 20 + 10 − (20×10)/100 = 28%; selling price = 500 × (1 − 0.28) = 500 × 0.72 = ₹ 360. Full solution: After first discount, price = 500 × 0.80 = ₹ 400; after second discount, price = 400 × 0.90 = ₹ 360.

questions.text: What is the correct sequence of components in a reflex arc through which a nerve impulse travels during a reflex action?

options.label: A
options.text: Receptor → Interneuron → Sensory Neuron → Motor Neuron → Effector

options.label: B
options.text: Receptor → Sensory Neuron → Interneuron → Motor Neuron → Effector

options.label: C
options.text: Sensory Neuron → Receptor → Interneuron → Motor Neuron → Effector

options.label: D
options.text: Effector → Motor Neuron → Interneuron → Sensory Neuron → Receptor

questions.solution: Shortcut: Use the mnemonic 'RSIME' (Receptor, Sensory neuron, Interneuron, Motor neuron, Effector). The impulse flows from the receptor towards the CNS via sensory neuron, crosses synapse to interneuron, then to motor neuron, and finally to the effector. Full Method: A reflex arc starts at the Receptor (detects stimulus) → Sensory Neuron (carries to spinal cord) → Interneuron (relay in spinal cord) → Motor Neuron (carries to effector) → Effector (muscle/gland responds).

questions.text: A car travels from point A to point B at a speed of 60 km/h and returns from B to A at a speed of 40 km/h. What is the average speed of the car for the entire journey?
questions.solution: Shortcut: For equal distances, average speed is the Harmonic Mean of speeds: 2ab/(a+b) = (2 * 60 * 40) / (60 + 40) = 4800 / 100 = 48 km/h. Step-by-step: Let distance be d km. Time for onward = d/60 hrs, return = d/40 hrs. Total distance = 2d. Total time = d/60 + d/40 = 5d/120 = d/24. Average speed = Total Distance / Total Time = 2d / (d/24) = 48 km/h.

questions.text: Arrange the following major events of the Indian Freedom Struggle in correct chronological order (Earliest to Latest): 1. Jallianwala Bagh Massacre 2. Non-Cooperation Movement 3. Quit India Movement 4. Partition of Bengal
questions.solution: Shortcut: Use anchor years for rapid elimination. Partition of Bengal (1905) is the earliest. Jallianwala Bagh (1919) precedes Non-Cooperation (1920-22). Quit India (1942) is the latest. Only Option A follows the sequence 1905 -> 1919 -> 1920 -> 1942. Worked Solution: Partition of Bengal by Lord Curzon occurred in 1905. Jallianwala Bagh Massacre took place on April 13, 1919. Non-Cooperation Movement was launched by Gandhi in September 1920. Quit India Movement started in August 1942. The correct chronological order is 4, 1, 2, 3.

questions.text: In a certain code language, 'CAT' is written as 'DCW' and 'DOG' is written as 'EQJ'. How will 'FOX' be written in that language?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Observe the first letter shift: C→D (+1), D→E (+1). So F→G. Only options B and C start with G. Check second letter: A→C (+2), O→Q (+2). So O→Q. Option B (GQA) matches. Full Solution: The pattern is positional increment: 1st letter +1, 2nd letter +2, 3rd letter +3. For FOX: F(6)+1=G(7); O(15)+2=Q(17); X(24)+3=27→A(1) (wrap around). Code is GQA.

questions.text: A soldier runs 8 km North, then turns right and runs 6 km. What is the straight-line distance (in km) from his starting point to his final position?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Recognize the legs 6 and 8 as multiples of the 3-4-5 Pythagorean triplet (2×3=6, 2×4=8). Hypotenuse = 2×5 = 10 km. Full Solution: The path forms a right-angled triangle with perpendicular sides 8 km (North) and 6 km (East). Distance = √(8² + 6²) = √(64 + 36) = √100 = 10 km.

questions.text: In what ratio must tea costing ₹120 per kg be mixed with tea costing ₹150 per kg so that the mixture costs ₹135 per kg?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Apply Alligation Rule. Cheaper = 120, Dearer = 150, Mean = 135. Difference (Mean - Cheaper) = 15. Difference (Dearer - Mean) = 15. Required Ratio = 15 : 15 = 1 : 1. Step-by-step: Let quantities be x kg and y kg. (120x + 150y) / (x + y) = 135 => 120x + 150y = 135x + 135y => 15y = 15x => x : y = 1 : 1.

questions.text: Two electric bulbs rated 60 W–220 V and 100 W–220 V are connected in series across a 220 V supply. Which bulb will glow brighter?
questions.solution: Shortcut: At rated voltage, Resistance R = V²/P. Lower power rating means higher resistance. In a series circuit, current (I) is same; actual power dissipated P_actual = I²R ∝ R. Hence, the bulb with higher resistance (60 W) glows brighter. Worked: R₆₀ = 220²/60 ≈ 807 Ω; R₁₀₀ = 220²/100 = 484 Ω. Since R₆₀ > R₁₀₀ and current is common, the 60 W bulb dissipates more power.

questions.text: Who was the first Indian citizen to travel to space?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Eliminate Kalpana Chawla & Sunita Williams (US Astronauts, Indian origin but not Indian citizens at time of flight). Eliminate Vikram Sarabhai (Father of Indian Space Programme, never flew). Rakesh Sharma flew on Soyuz T-11 (1984) as an IAF pilot. Full Solution: Wing Commander Rakesh Sharma became the first Indian citizen in space on 3 April 1984 aboard the Soviet Interkosmos mission Soyuz T-11 to the Salyut 7 space station. Kalpana Chawla and Sunita Williams were NASA astronauts of Indian origin.

questions.text: The Revolt of 1857, often regarded as the First War of Indian Independence, started from which city?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Eliminate Delhi (capture came later), Kanpur (Nana Sahib joined later), and Lucknow (Siege started later). The mutiny sparked on 10 May 1857 at Meerut when sepoys refused greased cartridges. Full Solution: The immediate trigger was the refusal of the 3rd Light Cavalry at Meerut to use the new Enfield rifle cartridges on 10 May 1857. They marched to Delhi the next day, proclaiming Bahadur Shah Zafar as Emperor.
